# ring extraction — measured 2026-11-12

Receipt for `specs/rewards.md` §7 "the cartel bound" and "the external-attention gate", §15 (unit P14b of tru#45: every frontier of §15 closed into a rule). Harness `rs/examples/ring_extraction.rs` at tru `0f70b0f` (branch `spec/rewards-complete`). Machine: build-a (Akash, 2 × Intel Xeon Platinum 8168 @ 2.7 GHz, 96 hardware threads; rustc 1.99.1 installed under `/srv/build/scratch/p14b/rust`, cargo 1.99.1), one solve thread. Data: the pussy-rc genesis export of 2026-11-02 (`soft3 genesis build --chain pussy-rc … --export`, the frames of `/var/lib/soft3/pussy-rc/genesis.tade`, copied on build-a from `/srv/build/scratch/review-46/data/`, the receipt data of tru#46): 29,113 link frames → 26,805 axons over 16,273 particles, weighted by the chain's rule `g(f) = max(1, ⌊B(author)/L(author)⌋)` (chain-economy §4.1), `Σ G = 41,802,483,829,015,338`. Supply `S0 = 1,099,389,810,279,114,036`, `SUBSIDY = 10,458,426,657`, `L = 240`.

```
git clone --branch spec/rewards-complete https://github.com/cyberia-to/tru.git   # siblings: hemera, strata, honeycrisp of review-46
cargo build -p cyber-tru --release --example ring_extraction
target/release/examples/ring_extraction /srv/build/scratch/p14b/tru 64 pussy 1    # 74 s wall
target/release/examples/ring_extraction /srv/build/scratch/p14b/tru 256 pussy 1   # 75 s wall
```

## 1. what is settled

One epoch from the genesis graph `A_prev = G` to `A_cur = net_axons(G, positions)`, settled by the exact rule of rewards.md §7 and chain-economy §5: the four-node path gradient (`tru::focusing::epoch::path_gradient`, `EpochParams::default()`), `a(c) = Δs·σ·ḡ`, `x(c) = max(0, a(c))` (every position is a new high on an unstaked side, so `N/R = 1`), the budget `B = L · cut`, `cut = SUBSIDY · min(5,000, isqrt(active · 10^8 / supply)) / 10^4` — one epoch's accrual, the steady state of the quarter release (chain-economy §5.5, §6.1) — and `pay(c) = min(⌊Δs/100⌋, ⌊B · x / X⌋)`.

The honest swarm: `honest` positions (64, then 256) raising existing axons by 30 % with valence +1 (the receipt's players of tru#46). The cartel: a ring of `k` colluders, `k ∈ {2, 4, 8, 16, 32, 64}`, each locking `s ∈ {10^11, 10^12, 10^13, 10^14}` with valence +1 on one axon of a cycle over `k` fresh particles; `anchored` adds one link of stake `s` from the heaviest existing particle (by out-weight) into the ring. Beside the exact payout, the external-attention gate of rewards.md §7: `ext(R)` the pre-existing weight entering the position's region (the closure of its endpoints under the epoch's new axons) from outside, `int(R)` the stake this epoch's positions put on axons into it, `x` scaled by `min(1, ext/int)`, then the same budget rule ("gated" columns). Integers throughout; floats only in the printing.

## 2. reading

- An isolated ring earns nothing at every `k` and every `s`, under the exact rule alone: its attribution is ≤ 0 (new particles spread the focus; `J = D_KL(φ ‖ u)` falls), and under the gate it has `ext = 0`. The honest swarm's payout is unchanged by it (404,004,032 at 64 honest; 808,008,064 at 256).
- An anchored ring earns nothing up to `s = 10^12` per colluder (its attribution is still negative). From `s = 10^13` — a ring stake of 0.6–9× the honest swarm's — its attribution turns positive and it takes 93–99.99 % of the budget; the honest swarm's pulse falls to 18 % (k = 2, 64 honest) and lower as `s` grows.
- The cartel's take relative to its stake is at most 0.070 % per epoch (k = 2, s = 10^13, 256 honest: ring stake 3 × 10^13, H = 5.1 × 10^13; the bound `L · SUBSIDY · √((R + H)/S0) / R` gives 0.072 %) and falls as `1/√R`: 0.015 % at 3 × 10^14, 0.003 % at 6.5 × 10^15. The per-position cap of 1 % never binds above `R ≈ 6 × 10^10`; the budget does.
- The gate restores the honest swarm's pulse: at `s = 10^13` to 100 % of its ungated value in every row; at `s = 10^14` to 100 % in all rows but one (k = 2, 64 honest: 83 %). The ring keeps most of the budget its own stake inflated (`B` grows as `√active`), which is the law paying descent: a stake that dwarfs the swarm's moves the focus.
- The budget itself: 5.5 × 10^9 PUSSY an epoch at the honest swarm of 64 alone (θ = 5 × 10^-6, 23 bps), 1.9 × 10^11 at the largest ring (θ = 6 × 10^-3, 770 bps) — the cartel funds the budget it takes.

## 5. what the numbers fix in the specification

`specs/rewards.md` §7: the cartel bound `min(⌊R/100⌋, B)` per epoch, once per new high, `B = L · SUBSIDY · min(½, √((R + H)/S0))`, measured 0.070 % at most; the external-attention gate `x(c) ← ⌊x(c) · min(1, ext(R)/int(R))⌋`, measured: the isolated ring at 0 under both, the honest pulse restored from 18 % to 83–100 %. §15: the collusion and self-dealing rows cite this file.

Columns: `ring x share` is the ring's share of `Σ x` (the attribution before the budget); `ring paid / ring stake` is the take per epoch relative to the stake it locked for seven days; `cap Σ⌊s/100⌋` is the per-position cap summed over the ring; `ext(region)`, `int(region)` are of the ring's region; the two `gated` columns are the payouts under the gate.
